Cast — as part of a normal Install check

Frequency once per augment, ever

Deliberately push an install past its rating, on purpose this time.

You know exactly which wire to leave a little too hot. Once per cyber-augment you personally install, you may choose to apply the Install Mishap table's "Overclocked in" result — +1 effective grade, +2 Drift instead of the listed value — without rolling and without needing a critical failure. You don't get to keep the grade bump if the augment is ever serviced, same as if you'd rolled it.
